In Jodhpur it is supplied, installed and serviced by Yamini Enterprises, the exclusive dealer and service provider for Hitachi HVAC Solutions by Bosch Home Comfort Group in Jodhpur. Key features include Auto Coil Dry, Big Flow Deflector, Wave Blade Design and Tropical Inverter.
